2_hazard_identification.source_reference: Official McKesson SDS, revision 2015-09-18, section 2, page 1

prevention: Keep away from heat, sparks, open flames, and hot surfaces.
Ground and bond container and receiving equipment.
Wear protective gloves, protective clothing, eye protection, and face protection.
response: In case of fire, use carbon dioxide, dry chemical, or foam.
disposal: Dispose of contents and container at an approved waste-disposal facility.

data.other_hazards: The SDS states that the product is toxic to aquatic life with long-lasting effects.

4_first_aid_measures.source_reference: Official McKesson SDS, revision 2015-09-18, section 4, page 2

data.eyes: Rinse immediately with plenty of water, including under the eyelids, for at least 15 minutes.
data.skin: If skin irritation occurs, rinse the affected area with water.
data.inhalation: Move the exposed person to fresh air.
data.ingestion: Dilute by giving a large amount of water and call a physician or Poison Control Center.
data.most_important_symptoms_effects: Eye tearing, redness, and discomfort; gastrointestinal disturbance; inhalation may cause giddiness or loss of consciousness.

5_fire_fighting_measures.source_reference: Official McKesson SDS, revision 2015-09-18, section 5, page 2

specific_hazards: Vapors may travel to an ignition source and flash back.
Alcohol flames may be difficult to see because they are virtually colorless.
data.firefighter_protection: Wear pressure-demand self-contained breathing apparatus approved by MSHA/NIOSH or equivalent and full protective gear.
special_methods: Use cool water to cool equipment and disperse vapors.

6_accidental_release_measures.source_reference: Official McKesson SDS, revision 2015-09-18, section 6, pages 2-3

personal_precautions: Use personal protective equipment as required.
protective_equipment: Appropriate PPE for the spill conditions.
environmental_precautions: Prevent further leakage or spillage when safe.
Consult the ecological information in SDS section 12.
containment: Contain spills larger than one gallon.
cleanup: Small spills under one gallon may be washed down a drain with plenty of water or cleaned and disposed of through a sanitary sewer system where permitted.
Large spills should be absorbed with sand, clay, or another absorbent, or vacuumed, collected, and properly disposed of.

7_handling_and_storage.source_reference: Official McKesson SDS, revision 2015-09-18, section 7, page 3

safe_handling: Keep away from heat, sparks, open flames, and hot surfaces.
Use spark-proof tools and explosion-proof equipment.
Ground and bond containers and receiving equipment.
storage_conditions: Store in a dry, cool, well-ventilated place.
Do not contaminate food or feed.
Keep out of reach of children.
